issue.title: Federation IPC tests fail because the AF_UNIX socket path is too long

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Both nodes fail deterministically, not intermittently. The helper thread at tests/test_dispatch_federation.py:632 calls server.bind on a pytest tmp socket and raises OSError: AF_UNIX path too long. The test then waits 1s for a ready Event that never sets (line 644). Pytest records the same OSError as an unhandled thread exception for both tests. The workspace path is long enough that the socket path exceeds the sun_path limit. A rerun was not a pass. The second node is tests/test_dispatch_federation.py::test_ipc_client_rejects_oversized_response. Proposed by phase sase-1i4.1. Not caused by the agent-scope reaper.

issue.creation_reason: Phase sase-1i4.1 reported these federation IPC tests fail on a clean tree. Landing reproduced both on master a10a6c6035: the server thread dies with OSError AF_UNIX path too long, so the ready event never sets.
